name: opencode-delegate
description: Delegate Claude Code work to FREE models from OpenCode Zen, OpenKilo, Cline, Pi and (optionally) Clixad via the opencode CLI, with automatic fallback, cooldowns, provider-wide pauses and auto-quarantine, to conserve Claude tokens. Consult mode for classification/summaries/lookups; BUILD mode (apply=true) for mechanical, well-scoped file edits.
